description:
Set a profile as the primary profile. The previous primary profile becomes secondary.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

profile_id.description: Profile ID to set as primary

name: set_primary_profile

outputSchema.description: A sub-account as its owner sees it

avatar_url.description: A URL or a data URI; null once cleared

email_theme.description: Theme of this sub-account's emails; null when unset (read as `dark`).

profile_id.description: The public id used in profile URLs

proof_order.description: Who decided the order of a profile's proofs. `default`: domain, social account, Telegram bot, email, phone, wallet, then each proof's `display_order`. `owner`: the owner's `display_order` alone — send it when the owner reorders. The first shown proof that is not hidden leads the profile's preview card, share tags and badge. Omitted on an update, the profile keeps its current setting.

public_proofs.description: The shown proofs, in the order the public profile shows them

support_email.description: Support address shown in this sub-account's messages; null when unset.

username.description: Absent until a username is claimed

verification_level.description: Always 'basic'; no levels are computed; removed in the next major.
